raw_response:
My field is only 1.5 mu, so I manage it carefully but I cannot afford big mistakes. Here is how I think through this year.

**Winter wheat (October to June):**
Last year I planted Jimai 22, it yielded well — about 450 kg/mu. I will plant the same variety again, hybrid seed from the agro-supply store in town, about 15 kg seed for my 1.5 mu. I till with a rotary tiller, rented from a neighbor who runs the service — 40 yuan per mu is the going rate.

For fertilizer, I follow what I have done the last few years but I have learned from the county extension that we over-apply nitrogen here. Still, I would rather have a bit extra than risk a poor harvest. I apply compound fertilizer (15-15-15) as base, about 50 kg per mu at sowing — that gives me roughly 7.5 kg each of N, P, K. Then at jointing (March) I topdress with urea, about 25 kg per mu — that is another 11.5 kg N. Total N about 18-19 kg/mu, P around 7.5, K around 7.5. Less than my neighbors who dump 30+ kg N, but my yields are similar.

Irrigation — I use well water. Wheat needs water at sowing (mengshui), at jointing, and at grain filling. Three irrigations is standard. If spring is very dry I add one at booting.

Pesticides — I spray herbicide once in early spring for broadleaf weeds, and once for aphids and powdery mildew around late April. Sometimes a second fungicide spray at flowering if I see fusarium risk. Call it 3 applications.

**Summer maize (June to September):**
After wheat harvest I go straight to maize — no time to plough, I use no-tillage direct seeding with the rented seeder. Zhengdan 958 hybrid, about 3 kg seed for 1.5 mu.

Fertilizer: 50 kg compound (15-15-15) at sowing, then urea topdress at big trumpet stage around 20 kg/mu. N about 16.5, P 7.5, K 7.5. Maize responds well to topdressing so I focus money there.

Irrigation: maize is in rainy season but July can be dry. I irrigate once at sowing if soil is dry, and once at tasseling. 2 times usually.

Pesticides: one spray for corn borer at whorl stage, sometimes one for armyworm. 2 applications.

Expected yields: wheat 450 kg/mu, maize 550 kg/mu. On 1.5 mu that is mostly for family grain and some sold.
